caseName: United States ex rel. Annaloro v. Elias
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Annaloro v. Elias, Correctional Superintendent
judges: Application, Consideration, Douglas, Granted, Should, Took

opinions.text:
Pending appeal to C. A. 3d Cir. Renewed application for bail pending appeal denied.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that bail should be granted. Mr. Justice Brennan took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
